title: 回购翻倍：市场为何不买账，贝森特称都是噪音
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Anything that happens within a 24-hour period is noise, and I think that once the market understands that we are focusing on physical consolidation, and that we are trying to bring the market back into equilibrium in a thinly-traded market.
segments.zh: 24小时内发生的事都是噪音，一旦市场明白我们专注于物理整合，并试图在流动性不足的市场中恢复平衡。

segments.en: To ignore the noise, Bessent says, Madrid pay, at this point, how desperate is Scott Bessent looking?
segments.zh: 贝森特说忽略噪音，但此时，斯科特·贝森特看起来有多急切？

segments.en: I mean, there's a credibility question, is there not? When you see that Bond rally actually not lasting that long?
segments.zh: 我的意思是，存在可信度问题，不是吗？当你看到债券涨势实际上没有持续那么久时。

segments.en: So, I think there is, of course, a credibility question. You can see that kind of playing out, I think, in the dollar, and how the dollar's kind of moving.
segments.zh: 所以，我认为当然存在可信度问题。你可以看到这在美元及其走势中有所体现。

segments.en: But I think the US comes at it from a position of strength that maybe other countries would really, really struggle to compete with.
segments.zh: 但我认为美国是从实力地位出发，其他国家可能很难与之竞争。

segments.en: When you're talking about one of the most deep and most liquid kind of bond markets, the approach of the Treasury really does have a lot of weight.
segments.zh: 当你谈论的是最深度、最具流动性的债券市场之一时，财政部的做法确实很有分量。

segments.en: And I think you could see, at least from the initial announcement that was made about buybacks, the move in markets that people are listening, and they're looking at what the Treasury is doing.
segments.zh: 我认为你可以看到，至少从最初宣布回购时，市场的反应表明人们在倾听，并关注财政部的行动。

segments.en: I think the challenge is that markets have maybe had some time to think about it, and have realised that actually scaling up the buybacks doesn't necessarily tip the scales.
segments.zh: 我认为挑战在于，市场可能花了一些时间思考，并意识到扩大回购规模并不一定能改变局面。

segments.en: When you look at the scale of long-end issuance, but also the scale of the US deficit, and where that's set to go.
segments.zh: 当你看到长期债券发行的规模，以及美国赤字的规模及其未来走向时。

segments.en: And I think that also reads across to lots of other European countries.
segments.zh: 我认为这也适用于许多其他欧洲国家。
